title: 第3章 中戏出演员，北电出明星，上戏？？？-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》
content:
第(1/3)页

    “终于回来了。”

    出了虹桥国际机场，魏沐招了辆出租车前往上戏。

    上戏作为华夏三大戏剧院校，存在感比中戏、北电“弱一点”。

    不知从何时开始，娱乐圈里流传着这样一句话：中戏出演员、北电出明星。

    想到这，魏沐都替自己母校尴尬。

    明明是三个学校的游戏，为什么上戏却不能拥有姓名？

    是不配吗？

    不管配不配，好歹是三大院校，总比不知名艺术院校强。

    魏沐带着这样的想法走进了上戏的校园。

    来到宿舍门口，发现门是虚掩着，里面传来了男性的吼叫声。

    打开门，眼前的一幕十分精彩。

    只见郑恺和杜江一人架着陈贺的一条腿，正要往阳台的门上撞。

    卧艹，挺会玩啊。

    魏沐不知道这样的行为在魔都叫什么，反正在他们那叫“阿鲁巴”

    场面一度有些尴尬，四人你看看我我看看你，相顾无言。

    停顿了几秒，郑恺和杜江把陈贺放下来，三人整了整衣服，当做什么事都没发生。

    魏沐直接忽视他们的动作，张开双臂大声呐喊，“你们的大哥回来啦！”

    “艹，狗东西，竟然还知道回来。”

    “啊？当上了男主就想翻身做老大啦？”

    在一阵笑骂声中，三人分别和魏沐抱了一下。

    魏沐记得原身和大学舍友关系非常好。

    晨跑的时候没少给这帮孙子带早餐。

    他们在同一屋檐下住了三年多，彼此都很熟悉。

    陈赤赤直接问道，“你不是去香江演戏了吗？这么快就回来了？？”

    说到这，郑恺和杜江的眼神里充满羡慕。

    “嗐，别提了，剧组停工，我就不应该去。”，魏沐露出懊悔的神色。

    三人惊呼，“啊？”

    这可和他们想的不一样，陈贺以为对方回来是有什么手续要办，毕竟他要去香江拍戏。

    结果剧组竟然停工了？？

    看到他们惊讶的表情，魏沐眉眼下垂，开始大倒苦水。

    “这件事真的挺操蛋，要不是我亲身经历我都不敢相信。”

    杜江眉毛一挑，身体前倾，像极了吃瓜群众发现新瓜的样子，“什么事？”

    “长话短说，制片人老婆跟人跑了，顺便把制片人的钱一齐卷走。制片人一气之下卷款跑路。”

    “他把剧组的钱卷走了？”

    魏沐轻轻点头，“投资人已经报警，警察正在搜人，但是追回投资的希望渺茫。”

    “我靠，头一次听说还有这种事。”
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Finally back."

After leaving Hongqiao International Airport, Wei Mu hailed a taxi and headed to the theater.

As one of the three major drama schools in China, Shanghai Theater Academy’s presence is “a little weaker” than that of China Theater Academy and Nortel.

I don’t know since when, there has been a saying in the entertainment industry: China Opera produces actors, and Nortel produces stars.

Thinking of this, Wei Mu felt embarrassed for his alma mater.

It’s obviously a game between three schools, why can’t we have names when we are on the show?

Is it unworthy?

No matter whether it is worthy or not, it is better to be one of the three major art schools than an unknown art school.

Wei Mu walked into the theater campus with this idea.

When I arrived at the door of the dormitory, I found that the door was ajar, and a male roar came from inside.

Opening the door, the scene in front of you is very exciting.

I saw Zheng Kai and Du Jiang holding one of Chen He's legs and about to hit the balcony door.

Damn it, you are really good at playing.

Wei Mu doesn’t know what this kind of behavior is called in Shanghai. Anyway, it’s called “Aruba” there.

The scene was a little awkward for a while. The four of them looked at each other, speechless.

After a pause for a few seconds, Zheng Kai and Du Jiang put Chen He down, and the three of them straightened their clothes, pretending that nothing happened.

Wei Mu ignored their actions, opened his arms and shouted loudly, "Your big brother is back!"

"Fuck, you bitch, you actually know how to come back."

"Huh? Now that you've become the male lead, you want to become the boss?"

Amid a burst of laughter and scolding, the three of them hugged Wei Mu respectively.

Wei Mu remembers that he had a very good relationship with his college roommate.

During my morning run, I often brought breakfast to these grandchildren.

They have lived under the same roof for more than three years and are very familiar with each other.

Chen Chichi asked directly, "Didn't you go to Xiangjiang to act? Are you back so soon??"

Speaking of this, Zheng Kai and Du Jiang’s eyes were filled with envy.

"Hey, don't mention it. The crew has stopped working, so I shouldn't go." Wei Mu looked regretful.

The three of them exclaimed, "Huh?"

This is different from what they thought. Chen He thought that the other party had to go through some formalities when he came back. After all, he was going to Xiangjiang to film a movie.

As a result, the crew actually stopped working??

Seeing their surprised expressions, Wei Mu drooped his eyebrows and began to express his bitterness.

“This thing is really fucked up. I wouldn’t believe it if I hadn’t experienced it myself.”

Du Jiang raised his eyebrows and leaned forward, like a melon-eating crowd discovering a new melon, "What's the matter?"

"To make a long story short, the producer's wife ran away with someone, taking the producer's money with her. The producer was so angry that he took the money and ran away."

"He took away the crew's money?"

Wei Mu nodded lightly, "The investors have called the police and the police are searching for people, but there is little hope of recovering the investment."

“Damn, this is the first time I’ve heard of such a thing.”
